An export is split into exportChunks parts. The connector fetches each part by index with List.Transform over List.Numbers and combines them. This is chunk-index paging, not offset, cursor or next-link paging.
A single-chunk export is fetched once, without the chunk loop.
Parts are generated with List.Transform over List.Numbers, not Table.GenerateByPage or List.Generate.

paging-stop.text: Paging stops after the numChunks parts (List.Numbers(0, numChunks)) have been fetched and combined with Table.Combine. A numChunks value of 1 or less fetches a single part.

The export status is polled by recursion while exportStatus is RUNNING.
Export starts, and a RUNNING status triggers polling.

polling-rule.text: There is no sleep or interval: each poll immediately re-requests the status endpoint. The per-request timeout is #duration(0,0,3,0), which is 3 minutes. There is no overall timeout, and the recursion is unbounded. Terminal states are any exportStatus other than RUNNING, which is returned to the caller. A 404 raises Error.Record. EXPORT_STATUS_DONE is defined but never compared.

evidence.note: Recursive polling with no delay, a per-request Timeout of 3 minutes, and terminal states of not RUNNING or 404.
